 Alabama Republican gubernatorial candidate Tommy Tuberville had law enforcement escort a news reporter out of a Mobile campaign event Tuesday night.
 “Get him out,” Tuberville directed to staff as a Lagniappe reporter began asking the U.S. Senator about his 2020 campaign promise to donate his salary from Congress to Alabama veterans and their families.

 I'm forced to vote for his opposition, just in the hopes of basic competency, to say nothing of decency.

 Coach Clueless is a liar, and dependent on ignorant MAGA voters to elect him. Alabama deserves exactly what it will get if this Floriduh dimwit is its next Governor. Data centers and more taxes. Doug Jones is not perfect. But he is a good man, not a moron and he actually lives in Alabama.
